description: Find icons by name. Returns matching names and which of the four styles each one has. Names are kebab-case and compounds read base-first, so a mail icon with a tick is `mail-check`, not `check-mail`. Search the base word to find a family. Word order does not matter and a component name from another set is accepted as written, so `CheckCircle2` finds `circle-check`. Trust an empty result: it means the set has no such icon.

style.description: Only return icons that have this style.

name: search_icons
